description: This line plot illustrates the Micro F1 (%) scores achieved by four different methods—TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval—as a function of the number of samples generated, which is represented on the x-axis labeled “Number of Samples Generated” and spans from K=8 to K=64 with tick labels at intervals of K=16. The y-axis, labeled “Micro F1 (%)”, ranges from 25% to 50% and uses a linear scale. The blue line, representing TACRED, starts at approximately 22% at K=8, rises to about 28% at K=16, peaks near 30% at K=32, and then slightly declines to about 29% at K=64. The orange line, for TACRED-Revisit, begins at roughly 23% at K=8, increases to about 29% at K=16, reaches a plateau near 31% at K=32, and then slightly decreases to about 30% at K=64. The green line, corresponding to Re-TACRED, starts at approximately 35% at K=8, rises sharply to about 40% at K=16, peaks at 51% at K=32, and then declines to about 48% at K=64. The red line, for SemEval, begins at about 42% at K=8, steadily increases to approximately 45% at K=16, reaches about 47% at K=32, and continues to rise to approximately 51% at K=64.
